Ash sentiu o sangue ferver. Anos de provocações acumuladas pesavam em seus ombros. Ele sabia que, em termos de conhecimento e talento natural, Gary sempre andava um passo à frente. Uma ideia súbita, bizarra e completamente irracional cruzou sua mente. Se ele vencesse Gary em uma batalha, seria difícil. Mas e se ele vencesse o rival de uma forma totalmente diferente?

Decidido a pegar o garoto completamente desprevenido, Ash deu um passo à frente, fingindo que ia estender a mão para um aperto de paz. Gary riu, erguendo a sobrancelha em sinal de zombaria.

— O que foi, Ash? Vai desistir antes de...

Antes que Gary pudesse terminar a frase, a mandíbula de Ash se abriu de maneira antinatural e impossível. Com uma velocidade impressionante, Ash avançou sobre o rival, engolindo Gary Oak inteiro em uma única e colossal investida. O corpo de Gary passou por sua garganta com um baque abafado, desaparecendo completamente dentro do estômago de Ash.

Os torcedores piscaram, atordoados, olhando para o espaço vazio onde Gary estava segundos antes. Ash fechou a boca, limpou um pouco de saliva do queixo e deu um tapinha satisfeito em sua barriga, que agora ostentava uma protuberância redonda e inconfundível no formato de seu rival.

Dentro do estômago, os ácidos gástricos começaram a agir imediatamente. Surpreendentemente, junto com a digestão física, ocorreu um fenômeno místico: os talentos nativos, o carisma e o vasto conhecimento sobre Pokémon de Gary Oak começaram a ser dissolvidos e absorvidos diretamente pelas paredes estomacais de Ash. Ash sentiu sua mente se expandir, seus reflexos aguçarem-se e uma onda de pura habilidade inata inundar suas veias. Ele agora possuía todo o potencial de Gary.

Sentindo-se revigorado e com a barriga estufada, Ash caminhou em círculos na praça, esfregando a palma da mão de maneira circular sobre o estômago dilatado.

— Ah, Gary... — provocou Ash em voz alta, falando diretamente para a própria barriga, enquanto ouvia abafados protestos e gemidos vindos do interior de seu corpo. — Parece que você ficou um pouco indigesto. Mas não se preocupe, seu talento vai me servir muito bem na Liga Pokémon. Você sempre quis ser o número um, não é? Bem, agora você faz parte de mim.

Horas se passaram. O processo digestivo foi implacável. Os ossos, roupas e pertences de Gary resistiram por mais tempo aos ácidos, mas eventualmente o corpo foi totalmente decomposto, restando apenas o esqueleto e alguns fragmentos metálicos de seus acessórios.

Sabendo que as autoridades e o Professor Carvalho começariam a procurar por Gary em breve, Ash sabia que precisava eliminar qualquer evidência incriminadora. Ele correu para a área arborizada atrás do laboratório, encontrando um arbusto denso e isolado.

Agachando-se cuidadosamente para garantir total privacidade, Ash fez força para evacuar os restos indesejados de sua refeição matinal. Com um suspiro de alívio, ele eliminou os resíduos biológicos juntamente com o esqueleto intacto de Gary Oak, que foi expelido para o meio da vegetação rasteira, perfeitamente oculto sob as folhas secas e a terra.

Levantando-se e ajeitando suas calças, Ash deu uma última olhada para o monte de terra, certificando-se de que nada pudesse ser visto. Com o talento de Gary agora firmemente integrado ao seu próprio ser e nenhuma evidência restante do ocorrido, Ash Ketchum virou-se e seguiu rumo ao laboratório do Professor Carvalho, pronto para iniciar sua jornada para se tornar um Mestre Pokémon.

Tristana and Poppy were two Yordles who lived in the League of Legends universe. They were both fierce fighters, but they had a problem - they were constantly in need of the bathroom.
Their rapid metabolisms and explosive digestive systems made it difficult for them to hold their waste for long periods of time. They would often have to sneak away from their duties to relieve themselves, and they were always at risk of being discovered.
One day, they were sent on a mission to retrieve an important artifact from the Institute of War. They knew it would be a dangerous task, but they were determined to succeed.
As they made their way through the Institute, they felt their bladders filling up. They tried to hold it in, but they couldn't resist the urge for long. They quickly found a hidden spot and relieved themselves, but they were interrupted by a group of enemy champions.
They fought bravely, but they were outnumbered and outmatched. Just when all hope seemed lost, they were saved by a group of their allies. They were grateful for their rescue, but they were also embarrassed by their predicament.
After the battle, they returned to their home base, relieved to have made it through alive. They knew they would have to be more careful in the future, and they made a pact to always make sure they had a proper bathroom break before embarking on any mission.
They continued to serve the League of Legends as valiantly as ever, but they never forgot their potty training lesson. They always made sure to take care of their bodily needs, and they became known as two of the most reliable and efficient Yordles in the league.

Write a League of Legends fanfic about Tristana and Poppy. They are both Yordles, and like all Yordles, they have rapid metabolisms and explosive digestive systems. They constantly need to potty and have trouble making it

output.extracted_text:
Sure, here is the answer to your request:

The afternoon sun beat down on the cobblestone paths of Bandle City, casting a warm glow over the vibrant, oversized flora that defined the Yordle capital. Tristana and Poppy were walking back from a long patrol near the border of the Whispering Woods, their heavy armor clanking with every step. 

Despite their short stature, Yordles possessed an energy that burned fiercely—along with metabolisms that processed food at an astonishingly rapid rate. Today, that particular biological quirk was proving to be a distinct inconvenience.

Poppy stopped abruptly, clutching her stomach with a small grimace. Her hammer dropped to the ground with a dull thud. "Tristana," she groaned, her face turning slightly pale. "That spicy root-stew we had at the tavern... I think it’s staging a rebellion."

Tristana, who had been marching a few paces ahead, stopped and turned back. A similar look of sudden panic crossed her own features as her insides let out a loud, unmistakable rumble. "Oh, no," Tristana whispered, crossing her legs tightly. "You too? I thought it was just the armor chafing."

"It's not the armor," Poppy said through gritted teeth, breaking into a desperate, waddling jog. "It's the digestive tract. You know how Yordle biology is—once it starts moving, it doesn't wait for permission."

"Formation broken!" Tristana yelped, abandoning military posture entirely as she sprinted past Poppy, her cannon forgotten on the ground. "First one to the public house in the market square wins, or disaster strikes!"

The race was on, though dignity was entirely absent. Zipping through the alleys of Bandle City, the two veteran warriors dodged startled glowing-toad vendors and giant mushrooms, their rapid-fire metabolism demanding an immediate pit stop. Every bounce and bound threatened catastrophic failure.

Poppy took a shortcut through a patch of oversized fern leaves, pushing her short legs to their absolute limit. "I see the sign!" she wheezed, pointing toward the welcoming chimney of the Prancing Pony tavern just fifty yards ahead. 

"Don't talk, just run!" Tristana gasped, her eyes watering from the sheer concentration required to hold everything together. 

With a final, desperate burst of speed that rivaled their battlefield charges, both Yordles hurdled the tavern's front steps, threw open the heavy oak door, and scrambled toward the back hallway. 

A collective sigh of immense relief echoed down the corridor moments later, proving that even the bravest heroes of Runeterra are ultimately no match for Yordle biology.
